standard.summary: ChimeraHydra 是 HydraLoRA v2 思路：内容专家池和频率/FEI 专家池双路相加。当前是 default-off primitive，不会改变现有 hydralora。
standard.effect: 内容 routing 负责语义/概念，频率 routing 负责纹理或频域特征，两路 delta 相加。
standard.whenToUse: 后续多概念、多风格或频率特征明显的 Anima/Newbie LoRA A/B。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要当前 HydraLoRA 稳定行为；ChimeraHydra 尚未接 request/config 和 checkpoint 路线。

standard_en.summary: ChimeraHydra follows the HydraLoRA v2 idea: a content expert pool and a frequency/FEI expert pool added together. It is currently an off-by-default primitive and changes nothing about the existing hydralora.
standard_en.effect: Content routing handles semantics and concepts, frequency routing handles texture or frequency-domain features, and the two deltas are summed.
standard_en.whenToUse: Later A/B work on Anima/Newbie LoRAs with multiple concepts, multiple styles, or pronounced frequency features.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you need the current HydraLoRA's stable behaviour. ChimeraHydra is not yet wired into the request/config or checkpoint routes.

advanced.principle: 双池 MoE-LoRA 使用两个 routing 分布生成 additive delta，并拒绝静态 merge。
advanced.intervention: Adapter primitive → future adapter registry → live routing loader。
advanced.expectedImpact: 可能提升容量和细节分工，但推理端必须支持 live dual-pool routing。
advanced.tradeoffs: 文件和计算开销高于普通 LoRA，不能静默替换 hydralora。

advanced_en.principle: Dual-pool MoE-LoRA uses two routing distributions to generate an additive delta and refuses static merge.
advanced_en.intervention: Adapter primitive → future adapter registry → live routing loader.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: May improve capacity and detail division of labor, but the inference side must support live dual-pool routing.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: File and compute overhead above ordinary LoRA; must not silently replace hydralora.
